findings: The implementation requires the old receipt candidate to equal the target candidate, so it cannot perform a cross-candidate rebind.
It requires invented profile and immutable-image fields absent from the retained real receipt.
It publishes only an unconsumed READY_FOR_REVIEWED_EXECUTION document and has no offline probe, retirement or compatible final PASS receipt path.
Evidence membership and path confinement are incomplete; destination-parent substitution and post-link fsync reconciliation remain unsafe.
disposition: REJECTED_NOT_EXECUTABLE; the reviewed existing tool-image producer was rerun once under a fresh release instead.
